# NGD Blog

> > NGD Blog is a comprehensive resource for learning design and animation tools, from beginner fundamentals to advanced techniques, serving the African creative community.

NGD Blog provides in-depth tutorials, comparisons, and tips for popular design and animation software including Figma, Photoshop, Canva, Pencil2D, and Synfig Studio. The site features both beginner-friendly guides and advanced workflows for UI/UX designers, digital artists, and animators.

## Key Topics

- Figma
- Photoshop
- 2D Animation
- UI/UX Design
- Pencil2D
- Synfig Studio
- Design Tools
- Canva Pro
- Sketch
- Beginner Guides
- Digital Design
- Animation Software
- Design Comparison
- Graphic Design
- Web Design

## UI/UX Design Tools

- [Figma for Beginners: Master UI/UX Design Fast [2024]](https://ngdblog.africa/figma-for-beginners-master-ui-ux-design-fast-2024): Comprehensive beginner's guide to mastering Figma for UI/UX design
- [Figma for Beginners: Get Started Fast in UI/UX 2025](https://ngdblog.africa/figma-for-beginners-get-started-fast-in-ui-ux-2025): Quick-start guide for beginners to learn Figma UI/UX design basics
- [Sketch Alternatives: Top 8 UI/UX Design Tools for 2025](https://ngdblog.africa/sketch-alternatives-top-8-ui-ux-design-tools-for-2025): Top 8 UI/UX design tool alternatives to Sketch for 2025

## 2D Animation & Motion Graphics

- [Pencil2D for Beginners: Create Stunning 2D Animations Today!](https://ngdblog.africa/pencil2d-for-beginners-create-stunning-2d-animations-today): Beginner's guide to Pencil2D for creating hand-drawn 2D animations
- [Synfig Studio Tips: Master 2D Animation in 2025](https://ngdblog.africa/synfig-studio-tips-master-2d-animation-in-2025): Tips and techniques for mastering Synfig Studio 2D animation software

## Photo Editing & Graphic Design

- [Crello vs Photoshop: Which Design Tool is Best for You in 2025?](https://ngdblog.africa/crello-vs-photoshop-which-design-tool-is-best-for-you-in-2025): Comparison of Crello and Adobe Photoshop design tools for creators
- [Canva Pro vs Photoshop: Which Tool is Best for You in 2025?](https://ngdblog.africa/canva-pro-vs-photoshop-which-tool-is-best-for-you-in-2025): Comparison between Canva Pro and Photoshop for design and content creation
- [BeFunky Tips: Master Design & Boost Workflow in 2025](https://ngdblog.africa/befunky-tips-master-design-boost-workflow-in-2025): Guide to mastering BeFunky photo editing and design workflow tips
- [Corel Painter Alternatives: Top 6 Picks for Artists 2025](https://ngdblog.africa/corel-painter-alternatives-top-6-picks-for-artists-2025): Top 6 digital painting software alternatives to Corel Painter for artists

## Design Career & Industry Insights

- [I Have Always Wanted To Work With A Big Brand… Amazon Is A Starting Point](https://ngdblog.africa/i-have-always-wanted-to-work-with-a-big-brand-amazon-is-a-starting-point): Designer career interview: NGD community member's journey to Amazon
